name: updateMediaItem
description: Changes a media item's details, such as its title, links, pictures or actions, found by its title.

title.description: The exact title of the media item.

newTitle.description: The item's new title, up to 70 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newSummary.description: Short text shown under the title, up to 250 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newBody.description: The item's formatted content, as HTML. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newSourceUrl.description: Link to where the media comes from. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newVideoUrl.description: Link to the video: an MP4, WebM or Ogg file, or a YouTube, Vimeo or Dropbox link. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAudioTitle.description: Title shown in the audio player, up to 70 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newArtists.description: Artists shown in the audio player, up to 70 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAudioUrl.description: Link to the audio file or stream. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

newThumbnailImage.description: Picture shown in the list and on the item's page, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newAudioImage.description: Picture shown in the audio player, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newAudioBackgroundImage.description: Picture shown blurred behind the audio player, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newMediaDate.description: The date shown for the item. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newActionLinks.description: Action buttons shown on the item's page, in order; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them all.

resetViews.description: Whether the item's view count starts again when its video or audio link changes. Leave it out to start it again only while view counts are hidden in the app.

callback.description: Runs when the item is changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, such as no item having that title, nothing to change, or an attempt to remove the title.

result.description: The media item as it now stands.

summary.description: The short text shown under its title.

sourceUrl.description: The link to where the media comes from.

audioTitle.description: The title shown in the audio player.

artists.description: The album artists shown in the audio player.

thumbnailImage.description: The picture shown in the list and on its page.

audioImage.description: The picture shown in the audio player.

audioBackgroundImage.description: The picture shown blurred behind the audio player.

actionLinks.description: The action buttons on its page, in order.

action.description: What the button does, such as opening a website.

rank.description: Its place in the manual order.

deepLinkUrl.description: The link that opens it in the app.
